Hello Freya,

We are the managing agent, Northbridge Lettings, for Flat 26, 46 Copperfield Walk, Kingshaven, ZZ5 7ZZ (our ref R/PM001-2). The landlord has confirmed he has received your quotes and agreed to proceed with the garden maintenance works.

Tenant's report: communal garden full of weeds (front and back), hedge along the side path overgrown, and a piece of unused land at the side of the property that still needs clearing. The side path provides access to the properties behind.

Access: the tenant reports no entry codes or alarms. There is one cat at the property, so please keep gates closed while working.

Please contact us with your proposed date(s) so we can confirm with the tenant, and send a copy of the quote the landlord accepted for our records, quoting R/PM001-2.

Thank you,
Northbridge Lettings
